simpleini v4.25
https://github.com/brofield/simpleini/releases/tag/v4.25
Vendored 2026-04-16.

Files:
  SimpleIni.h   - header-only INI parser (CSimpleIniA / CSimpleIniW)
  ConvertUTF.h  - Unicode conversion helpers used when SI_CONVERT_GENERIC is defined
  ConvertUTF.c  - implementation of the above
  LICENSE.txt   - MIT license (see upstream LICENCE.txt)

Only SimpleIni.h is actually included by the live tree right now; Revenant
uses CSimpleIniA (narrow-char). The ConvertUTF pair is bundled for future
use if we enable wide/UTF-8 conversion.
